# Bill of materials

Parts for one set: a detector, an emitter and a control board, plus the two
cables between them. Taken from the schematics on 2026-11-18:
UV-Detector v0.5, UV-Emitter v0.5, UV-Control v0.4, all still in progress, so re-check it against the schematics before
ordering.

The part numbers are suggestions; the schematics don't carry them yet. Any
equivalent passive works (same value and package, same or higher voltage and the
same dielectric, C0G where given). The Pro Micro module and the display aren't
sold by Digi-Key or Mouser.

Quantity 0 means the part has a footprint but isn't fitted, or is optional.
All resistors and capacitors are 0805. Order a few spares of the small parts:
cut-tape prices usually drop at 10 pieces.

The order list for one set is [`bom.csv`](bom.csv), by manufacturer part number, ready
for Digi-Key's or Mouser's BOM upload. The [web page](https://edgecollective.io/uv254/bom/) has the same
lists, scales the order to several sets and downloads it as CSV. The Buy links
search Digi-Key for each part number.

JP1 (solder jumper) and H1-H4 (mounting holes) have no part. J3 takes one shunt (Sullins SPC02SYAN); use J3 or JP1, never both. The display and the Pro Micro can be soldered straight to the board or plugged into 0.1 in sockets.

## Cables

Two cables, wired **pin 1 to pin 1** (ready-made JST PH cables are often
reversed, pin 1 to pin 6, and those don't work here):

| Cable | Ends | Parts |
|---|---|---|
| Control J1 to detector J2 | 7-pin JST PH | 2 JST [PHR-7](https://www.digikey.com/en/products/result?keywords=PHR-7) housings, 7 leads |
| Control J2 to emitter J2 | 6-pin JST PH | 2 JST [PHR-6](https://www.digikey.com/en/products/result?keywords=PHR-6) housings, 6 leads |

The leads are JST [ASPHSPH24K152](https://www.digikey.com/en/products/result?keywords=ASPHSPH24K152) (6 in, crimped at both
ends, pushed into the housings), 13 in all. Or crimp JST
[SPH-002T-P0.5S](https://www.digikey.com/en/products/result?keywords=SPH-002T-P0.5S) terminals onto 24-28 AWG wire.
All four links go to Digi-Key.

## Not in the design yet

The control board has no source for **V_LED** (the emitter's +12V, J2 pin 4)
until the boost for the UV LED is added, so its parts aren't listed. Until then,
feed V_LED from a bench supply on J5 pin 4. (J5 pin 3, 5V, isn't connected to
anything else.)
